name: Pleasing Your Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that a wife's role includes a respectful submission to her husband, reflecting her desire toward him as established in Genesis 3:16 and commanded in Ephesians 5:22. A virtuous and wise woman builds and strengthens her household, becoming a crown to her husband and inspiring his trust, as seen in Proverbs 12:4, 14:1, and 31:11-12. Pleasing one’s husband involves consistent goodness and faithfulness throughout life, fostering a God-honoring marriage grounded in mutual respect and biblical order.
